label: Original idea: a no-signal tag for ceiling: markers whose upgrade trigger names no measurable quantity, extending Ponytail's no-trigger tag (which checks a trigger exists) to check whether the trigger can ever fire in this repo. Target: the proposed debt report in sk-code-quality.

Original idea: extend citation resolution to agent and rule docs. validate.sh resolves SOURCE tags only inside spec folders, while .skilled/agents and .skilled/repo-rules cite file:line throughout; a bounded doctor-side lint would warn on stale citations across the whole instruction surface.

Original idea: one authored agent source per dialect, generated elsewhere. Three byte-identical OpenCode-dialect copies exist with no equality check; declare .skilled/agents the authored source and generate .opencode/agents and .hermes/agents in the existing sync pipeline, as four other hosts already do.

Original idea: a review-output contract fixture for the reproducing-case field once the finding format gains it; a parser check fails when a sample finding row omits its case, grading the contract deterministically the way the canary corpus grades routing. Target: sk-code-review tests.

Original idea: a vocabulary-parity check across the four routing surfaces (hub-router classes, mode-registry aliases, description keywords, canary corpus), modeled on the doctor's version parity: every alias asserted by the canary must resolve in the registries and every registry alias must be classifiable, failing with the missing surface named. Target: parent-skill-check or the compiled-routing gate.
